description: One Hero block; the variant is a block option (Hero (variant)). Each variant keeps its code and styles in variants/<option>.{js,css}.

variants.usageDescription: Default boilerplate hero: background image behind an H1.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width hero with a muted, looping Wistia background video (no controls) under a dark overlay, a centered H1 and pill CTAs
visualCharacteristics.description: No hero variants exist. Background is a looping muted Wistia video (not an image) under a dark overlay, with centered H1 + 2 pill CTAs.

contentPattern.summary: H1 'Biomek i-Series Automated Liquid Handlers' + 2 CTAs ('Explore Biomek i-Series Models' to #Compare_table, 'Talk to an Expert' to #form) over a background-loop Wistia video
contentPattern.structure: rows: (1) Wistia video URL, optional poster image; (2) H1 + CTA links (bold links render as buttons)

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for top-of-page banners whose background is a looping video. For an image background use hero.
variants.usageDescription: Full-width hero with a muted, looping Wistia background video (no controls) under a dark overlay, a centered H1 and pill CTAs.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Mid-page content-width dark promo banner: background photo behind a pink eyebrow, very large H2 and text, a 4-up bordered icon feature strip and a centred red CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Only hero variant is hero-video (Biomek): full-width page-top hero with looping Wistia background video, centered H1 and pill CTAs. This is a mid-page, content-width, left-aligned dark promo with an image background, eyebrow, oversized H2 and a bordered 4-up icon feature strip: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: Content-width dark banner: background photo, pink eyebrow 'SOFTWARE UPGRADE', huge white H2 'Vi-CELL BLU 2.0', paragraph, 4-up bordered feature strip (icon + title + description), centered red button 'Explore the upgrade'; extra software screenshot shown on mobile only
contentPattern.structure: block fields: (1) background image (`image`/`imageAlt`); (2) optional mobile image (`media_image`/`media_imageAlt`, empty row if none); (3) rich text `text`: eyebrow paragraph + H2 + paragraph + CTA link (strong-wrapped); then one row per feature (item hero-promo-feature): icon image (`image`/`imageAlt`) + rich text `text` (bold title paragraph + description)

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for in-page product/software promos on a dark background. For a page-top video hero use hero-video.
variants.usageDescription: Mid-page content-width dark promo banner: background photo behind a pink eyebrow, very large H2 and text, a 4-up bordered icon feature strip and a centred red CTA.
